'''Birak'k''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] living during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Upon the reappearance of the ancient Gree starship ''[[Gray Secant]]'', Birak'k set up a shop inside the [[Republic Recon Post]] while the Republic assisted the Gree with their research.
